details:
A way to see your own avatar as it appears when another player's safety settings have disabled parts of it.

Problem

When safety settings block animators, custom shaders, particles, or PhysBones, nothing communicates this back to the avatar's wearer. The viewer sees a degraded avatar; the wearer has no idea.

Concretely:

With custom shaders blocked, an avatar built around lilToon or similar falls back to a standard shader. Colors and transparency can break badly, and the wearer never sees it.

With the animator blocked, expressions, toggles, and gimmicks all stop. The mesh can end up in a default state the author never intended to be visible.

The same applies to PhysBones and particles being stripped under performance-based blocking.

The current failure mode is finding out only when someone tells you your avatar looks broken.

Proposed shape

A preview, in a mirror or in the menu, that can be toggled between:

Safety levels corresponding to the existing trust rank tiers

Individual features: custom shaders, animator, particles, PhysBones, audio, lights

The trust-rank view is the more useful of the two. Being able to check "this is what someone on Visitor settings sees" answers the question directly.

Include performance-based blocking

Blocking caused by performance rank should be covered by the same preview. If your avatar is Poor, you should be able to see what someone who blocks Poor avatars gets.

The SDK build panel reports the rank, but not what that rank actually causes to be stripped at runtime. This needs to be checkable inside VRChat rather than in Unity — most users running purchased avatars never open the project.

Why this matters

Safety settings work as intended, but they're a one-way channel. Avatar authors distribute content without knowing how it degrades, so they can't design around it. With a preview, authors can set up sensible shader fallbacks and reasonable default poses for when the animator is stopped, which improves the experience for exactly the users who have safety settings turned on.
title: Preview how your avatar appears to players with safety settings applied
